in_hebrew.name: Auberbach
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Elhaz (El) and rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Auberbach הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic elements Elhaz and Bach, meaning 'El (God) and rock'. This name is of German origin and has been used predominantly in Christian traditions.

in_latin.name: Auberbach
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Elhaz (El) and rock
in_latin.long_meaning: Auberbach est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Germanic elements Elhaz and Bach, meaning 'El (God) and rock'. This name is of German origin and has been used predominantly in Christian traditions.
